SOURCE DESK / PUBLIC RECORD

Help keep the map useful.

Suggest a public Singapore AI reference, correct a factual detail, or request removal. Every request is logged first; inclusion is based on public evidence, never payment.

Suggest a public reference

A public primary source is required. We do not list paid placements or private claims as public references.

What happens next

  1. Received — the request is recorded.
  2. Checked — an editor reads the linked public evidence.
  3. Published or noted — the change appears in the Navigator changelog when appropriate.

What this is for

Public references are an editorial starting point. They link to sources and do not imply endorsement, certification, a commercial relationship or a complete census.

Organisation profile?

For an organisation’s own listing, use Commons. Existing self-published profiles are managed by their owners.
